name: Montclair
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Montclair, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Montclair, CA: Holly Jolly Holiday, Santa's sleigh route, Santa photos and a free gingerbread afternoon at Montclair Place.
lede: Montclair keeps Christmas close to home, with a city tree lighting and a Santa sleigh that rolls through neighborhood streets, plus a mall full of Santa visits.
celebrates: The City of Montclair lists its holiday celebrations on its community events pages. The Holly Jolly Holiday at the Montclair Youth Center and Alma Hofman Park kicks off the season with Santa, snow and the tree lighting. A few days later, Dashing Through Montclair sends Santa, Mrs. Claus and their sleigh down a different set of streets each year, and the city collects toys for donation. The city also runs a Holiday Home Decoration Contest and a Holiday Food and Toy Basket Program. Montclair Place adds Santa Photos in Center Court, pet photo nights, a sensory friendly Santa hour, a gingerbread afternoon and a ballet Nutcracker.
lastyear: The City of Montclair has held the Holly Jolly Holiday for years at Alma Hofman Park. The city's page for the 2021 event described the evening as the start of the holiday season, with free photos with Santa, free refreshments while supplies lasted and a mailbox where children could drop a letter to Santa. Residents could also buy a gift light for the community holiday tree for $10, with proceeds going to youth programs. The 2026 page lists the event for December 3 and promises that Santa will make it snow.
facts: Dashing Through Montclair changes its route every year because the city says Montclair is too big for Santa to visit every street. Montclair Place is operated by CIM Group, and its events calendar for the season lists Santa Photos from November 13 through December 24, plus Pet Photos with Santa on two Wednesdays. The mall also hosts Inland Pacific Ballet on December 12 with no tickets needed, the same company that dances The Nutcracker at the Lewis Family Playhouse in nearby Rancho Cucamonga.
trains: Montclair is served by Metrolink, and the Montclair Transcenter is where the commuter trains stop in the city. There is no holiday train ride in Montclair itself, so families who want a Christmas train should look at our California Christmas train rides guide and plan a short drive to a nearby railway or garden railroad.
traditions: The city's tree lighting and snow night at the Montclair Youth Center and Alma Hofman Park.
Santa, Mrs. Claus and their sleigh visit neighborhood streets on a route that changes each year.
The city's past Holly Jolly Holiday events invited children to drop a letter to Santa in a special mailbox.
The city runs a contest for decorated homes, so neighborhood lights are part of the season.
Santa Photos in Center Court from November 13 through December 24, with pet and sensory friendly sessions.
kidfact: Santa's sleigh can not visit every street in Montclair, so the route changes every year and the city posts it online.
faq: When is the Montclair tree lighting in 2026?

The City of Montclair lists its Holly Jolly Holiday on Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 3 to 8:30 pm at the Montclair Youth Center and Alma Hofman Park, with the tree lighting ceremony in the evening, from 6:30 to 8:30 pm according to the city's page. The city cancels the event in bad weather, so check its page on the day.
Does Santa visit neighborhoods in Montclair?

Yes. Dashing Through Montclair on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from noon to 7 pm sends Santa, Mrs. Claus and their sleigh down Montclair streets. The route changes every year because the city is too big to cover at once, and the city plans to post the route and toy donation locations by December 1.
Where can kids meet Santa in Montclair?

Montclair Place lists Santa Photos in Center Court from November 13 through December 24, 2026, with online reservations. It also lists Pet Photos with Santa on December 2 and 9 and a sensory friendly Sensory Santa hour on December 13 from 9 to 10 am. The city's Holly Jolly Holiday on December 3 also features Santa.
Is there a free Christmas event in Montclair?

Montclair Place lists a free Gingerbread Extravaganza on Sunday, December 6, 2026, from 1 to 3 pm in Center Court, with cookie decorating, crafts, a live DJ and photos with the Gingerbread Man. The Inland Pacific Ballet Nutcracker afternoon on December 12 says no tickets are needed.
Are there Christmas train rides in Montclair?

Not in Montclair itself. Our California Christmas train rides guide lists Santa trains and holiday rides in the region, and Metrolink commuter trains stop at the Montclair Transcenter if you want a train outing without a car.
